title: Video by samalytics
description:
On August 14th, Reddit citations in ChatGPT dropped from 15%+ to basically zero ….overnight. Why? ChatGPT stopped crawling the open web and started querying specific sites directly (using a site: search operator). Now docs, help centers, and official company pages dominate citations instead of forums.

Reddit was getting gamed hard.. remember when a Reddit joke post led Google’s AI to suggest gluing cheese onto pizza? This shift is actually a quality correction.

But here’s the real point: a single architecture change just rewrote who gets visibility in AI search. If your brand’s distribution strategy still leans on forum seeding, it’s already outdated.

This is exactly the kind of shift that decides who wins and who gets left behind in the AI economy. 👇

Comment “LINK” and I’ll send you the link to join my AI Skool community, where I break down exactly how to move first on shifts like this.
